free.name: Kinetic Title Drop
free.makes: A six-second, three-beat kinetic type video (MP4, 1080p) for openers and announcements
free.makes_zh: 6 秒、三拍的动态字标题视频（MP4，1080p），用作开场和发布公告
free.ask: Make a 6-second kinetic title drop that says "Ship / it / today." in our brand orange, 1080p, for an X post.
free.ask_zh: 做一个 6 秒的动态标题，文字是「Ship / it / today.」，用我们的品牌橙色，1080p，发 X 用。

free.name: Pixel Quest Promo
free.makes: A 20-second 8-bit promo where a pixel hero runs one stage per feature, on a 120 BPM grid
free.makes_zh: 20 秒 8-bit 宣传片：像素小人每跑过一关讲一个功能，卡 120 BPM 节拍
free.ask: Make a Pixel Quest promo for our app: four stages for sync, search, share and offline.
free.ask_zh: 给我们的 App 做一条像素闯关宣传片：同步、搜索、分享、离线四关。

free.name: Swiss Grid Deck
free.makes: A Swiss-grid slide deck from your notes: browser deck, PDF and editable PPTX with speaker notes
free.makes_zh: 把笔记变成瑞士网格风幻灯片：网页版、PDF 和可编辑 PPTX，带演讲备注
free.ask: Turn notes.md into a 12-slide Swiss Grid deck for our board meeting, with speaker notes, and export PDF and PPTX.
free.ask_zh: 把 notes.md 做成 12 页瑞士网格风的董事会汇报，带演讲备注，导出 PDF 和 PPTX。

free.name: Editorial OG Card
free.makes: 1200×630 link-preview images for every blog post, with the meta tags wired up
free.makes_zh: 给每篇博客生成 1200×630 的分享卡片图，并接好 meta 标签
free.ask: Make Editorial OG cards for every post in /content/blog and save them next to each post.
free.ask_zh: 给 /content/blog 里每篇文章做分享卡片，存在文章旁边。

free.name: Blueprint Architecture Diagram
free.makes: A blueprint-style system diagram from your repo or a description, as HTML, SVG and PNG
free.makes_zh: 从代码库或一段描述画出蓝图风格的系统架构图，输出 HTML、SVG 和 PNG
free.ask: Read this repo and draw a Blueprint architecture diagram of the order service, with data flow animated.
free.ask_zh: 读一下这个仓库，画出订单服务的蓝图架构图，数据流做成动画。
